digest.component_or_area: code-review gate per-pass model class declarations
propositions: The code-review gate steps base, round_a, round_b and coach declare no per-pass model class and implicitly inherit the run's single resolved cfg.model, preventing per-pass model selection on non-default providers.
A single env var like REBAR_LLM_MODEL cannot express the required four-pass shape (Pass-1 on frontier/opus-family, Pass-2/Pass-4 on standard/sonnet-family).

Batch steps must declare a single-rung model_ladder rather than a step-level model:, because the batch path reads only the batch sub-dict and silently discards an enclosing step model, making a multi-rung ladder non-deterministic and untestable.

The code-review gate never honours any per-step model declaration at runtime; a live Bedrock-configured run showed every classed step (including verify's landed model: standard) running on the inherited direct-Anthropic default, proving the plumbing ignores the YAML.
YAML-token or resolver-helper unit tests pass vacuously because they never assert the model actually reaching each step at runtime, hiding the inert declaration defect.

A code-novelty sub-call leaks to direct Anthropic while classed steps run on Bedrock, so no-bare-claude-resolves-to-anthropic holds for steps but not for the whole run, meaning the Bedrock cutover is incomplete.
